sn47.14:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati ukkacelāyaṃ nadiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aciraparinibbutesu sāriputtamoggallānesu.
sn47.14:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
sn47.14:2.1: atha kho bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn47.14:2.2: “api ca khvāyaṃ bhikkhave, parisā suññā viya khāyati parinibbutesu sāriputtamoggallānesu
sn47.14:2.3: asuññā me sā bhikkhave, parisā hoti anapekhā tassaṃ disāyaṃ hoti, yassā disāyaṃ sāriputtamoggallānā viharanti.
sn47.14:2.4: ye’pi te bhikkhave, ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tesampi bhagavantānaṃ etaparamaṃ yeva sāvakayugaṃ ahosi,
sn47.14:2.6: ye’pi te bhikkhave, bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, tesampi bhagavantānaṃ etaparamaṃ yeva sāvakayugaṃ bhavissati, seyyathāpi mayhaṃ sāriputtamoggallānā.
sn47.14:2.7: acchariyaṃ bhikkhave, sāvakānaṃ abbhutaṃ bhikkhave, sāvakānaṃ
sn47.14:2.8: satthusamānā ca sāsanakarā bhavissanti ovādapatikarā catunnañca parisānaṃ piyā bhavissanti manāpā garubhāvanīyā ca.
sn47.14:2.9: acchariyaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgatassa, abbhutaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgatassa
sn47.14:2.10: evarūpepi nāma sāvakayuge parinibbute natthi tathāgatassa soko vā paridevo vā.
sn47.14:2.11: taṃ kutettha bhikkhave, yaṃ taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ, taṃ vata mā palujjīti
sn47.14:2.13: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato ye mahantatarā khandhā te palujjeyyuṃ,
sn47.14:2.14: evameva kho bhikkhave, mahato bhikkhusaṅghassa tiṭṭhato sāravato sāriputtamoggallānā parinibbutā.
sn47.14:2.15: taṃ kutettha bhikkhave, labbhā, yaṃ taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ, taṃ vata mā palujjīti
sn47.14:2.17: tasmātiha bhikkhave, attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.
sn47.14:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo
sn47.14:3.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.14:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.14:3.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
sn47.14:3.7: ye hi keci bhikkhave, etarahi vā mamaccaye vā attadīpā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā. tamataggo me te bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmāti.
